On which surfaces of the teeth is dental plaque most likely to accumulate in the mouth of a patient with poor oral hygiene?
Option A: The palatal surfaces of the upper molars and lingual surfaces of the lower incisors.
Option B: The buccal surfaces of the upper molars and lingual surfaces of the lower incisors.
Option C: The palatal surfaces of the upper molars and labial surfaces of the lower incisors.
Option D: The buccal surfaces of the upper molars and labial surfaces of the lower incisors.
